name: Runner Extras - TestPage page-variable-bound control
brief: Proves a TestPage control bound to a page GLOBAL VARIABLE (not Rec) can be read and written, and that its OnValidate trigger fires.
description: A page control does not have to bind to a source-table field. Binding one to a page global variable is ordinary AL and the standard way to build a filter/mode selector above a repeater. The runner's LiveNavTestPage is a record cursor: it maps only Rec-bound controls, and ToTableFieldNo falls through to the raw control id on a miss, so the control's FNV name hash reaches the record as a field number and NavNCLFieldNotFoundException is thrown with a number no field could ever have. Four Pageworks pages fail exactly this way. The negatives matter: writing the page variable must not touch the record's own fields, and the variable must not survive into a second page instance — a runner that stored control values in one process-wide dictionary would satisfy the positives alone.
